var __defProp = Object.defineProperty;
var __name = (target, value) => __defProp(target, "name", { value, configurable: true });

// entry.mjs
import { WorkerEntrypoint } from "cloudflare:workers";

// ../../probe-io.mjs
async function boundedText(response, maxBytes = 1024 * 1024) {
  const reader = response.body?.getReader();
  if (!reader) return "";
  const chunks = [];
  let size = 0;
  try {
    while (true) {
      const { value, done } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      size += value.byteLength;
      if (size > maxBytes) throw new Error("Diagnostic response exceeds byte limit");
      chunks.push(value);
    }
  } catch (error) {
    await reader.cancel(error);
    throw error;
  } finally {
    reader.releaseLock();
  }
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(size);
  let offset = 0;
  for (const chunk of chunks) {
    bytes.set(chunk, offset);
    offset += chunk.byteLength;
  }
  return new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(bytes);
}
__name(boundedText, "boundedText");
async function boundedJson(response, maxBytes) {
  return JSON.parse(await boundedText(response, maxBytes));
}
__name(boundedJson, "boundedJson");

// ../../backend/request-signal-probe.mjs
var python = `
import asyncio, json, sys, sysconfig, pyodide
from workers import WorkerEntrypoint, Response
class Default(WorkerEntrypoint):
    async def fetch(self, request):
        mode = json.loads(await request.text())["mode"]
        await self.env.EFFECTS.record("before")
        try:
            if mode != "cpu_abort":
                await asyncio.sleep(0.25)
            else:
                total = 0
                for value in range(20000000):
                    total += value
        except BaseException as exc:
            await self.env.EFFECTS.record("caught")
        await self.env.EFFECTS.record("after")
        return Response.json({"python": list(sys.version_info[:3]), "pyodide": pyodide.__version__,
                              "soabi": sysconfig.get_config_var("SOABI")})
`;
async function forwardSignalProbe(request, loader, effects, onParentAbort, waitUntil) {
  const body = await request.json();
  if (!body || !/^[a-f0-9-]{36}$/.test(body.id) || !["control", "io_abort", "cpu_abort"].includes(body.mode)) {
    return new Response("Fixed diagnostic only", { status: 422 });
  }
  request.signal.addEventListener("abort", () => {
    waitUntil(onParentAbort(body.id));
  }, { once: true });
  const worker = loader.load({
    compatibilityDate: "2026-10-30",
    compatibilityFlags: ["python_workers"],
    mainModule: "main.py",
    modules: { "main.py": { py: python } },
    env: { EFFECTS: effects(body.id) },
    globalOutbound: null,
    limits: { cpuMs: 1e3, subRequests: 4 }
  });
  return worker.getEntrypoint().fetch("https://attempt.invalid/", {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify({ mode: body.mode }),
    signal: request.signal
  });
}
__name(forwardSignalProbe, "forwardSignalProbe");

// policy.mjs
var SIGNAL_CASES = ["completion", "parent_abort", "io_abort", "cpu_abort"];
async function writeSignalLog(api, token, caseId, event) {
  if (!SIGNAL_CASES.includes(caseId) || !["preflight", "before", "caught", "after", "parent_abort_received"].includes(event)) {
    throw new TypeError("Fixed signal event only");
  }
  const response = await api.fetch(new Request("https://bifrost-pyodide-dev-ui-ddf316c1.midtown-technology-group.workers.dev/api/sdk/runtime/logs", {
    method: "POST",
    redirect: "manual",
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ level: "INFO", message: `signal:${caseId}:${event}` })
  }));
  await response.body?.cancel();
  return response.status;
}
__name(writeSignalLog, "writeSignalLog");
async function handleSignalProbe(request, env, effects, waitUntil) {
  if (!env.DEV_AUTH || request.headers.get("X-Dev-Auth") !== env.DEV_AUTH || !(Date.now() < Number(env.DEV_EXPIRES_AT))) {
    return new Response("Private qualification only", { status: 403 });
  }
  if (request.method !== "POST") return new Response("POST required", { status: 405 });
  let body;
  try {
    body = await boundedJson(request, 8192);
    if (!body || Object.keys(body).sort().join(",") !== "case_id,run_token" || !SIGNAL_CASES.includes(body.case_id) || typeof body.run_token !== "string" || body.run_token.length < 16 || body.run_token.length > 4096 || /[\r\n]/.test(body.run_token)) {
      throw new TypeError("Fixed input required");
    }
  } catch {
    return new Response("Fixed signal diagnostic only", { status: 422 });
  }
  const log = /* @__PURE__ */ __name((event) => writeSignalLog(env.DEV_API, body.run_token, body.case_id, event).then((status) => {
    if (status !== 200) throw new Error("Independent observer rejected event");
  }), "log");
  try {
    const status = await writeSignalLog(env.DEV_API, body.run_token, body.case_id, "preflight");
    if (status !== 200) return Response.json({ phase: "observer-auth", observer_status: status }, { status: 502 });
    if (["completion", "parent_abort"].includes(body.case_id)) {
      request.signal.addEventListener("abort", () => waitUntil(log("parent_abort_received")), { once: true });
      await log("before");
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, body.case_id === "completion" ? 100 : 2e3));
      await log("after");
      return Response.json({ parent_only: true });
    }
    const forwarded = new Request("https://fixed-signal.invalid/", {
      method: "POST",
      signal: request.signal,
      body: JSON.stringify({ id: crypto.randomUUID(), mode: body.case_id })
    });
    return await forwardSignalProbe(
      forwarded,
      env.LOADER,
      () => effects({ token: body.run_token, caseId: body.case_id }),
      () => log("parent_abort_received"),
      waitUntil
    );
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ phase: "signal-probe", error_type: error.name, physical_termination_verified: false }, { status: 502 });
  }
}
__name(handleSignalProbe, "handleSignalProbe");

// entry.mjs
var Effects = class extends WorkerEntrypoint {
  static {
    __name(this, "Effects");
  }
  async record(event) {
    if (!["before", "caught", "after"].includes(event)) throw new TypeError("Child event only");
    const status = await writeSignalLog(this.env.DEV_API, this.ctx.props.token, this.ctx.props.caseId, event);
    if (status !== 200) throw new Error("Independent observer rejected event");
  }
};
var entry_default = { fetch(request, env, ctx) {
  return handleSignalProbe(request, env, (props) => ctx.exports.Effects({ props }), (promise) => ctx.waitUntil(promise));
} };
export {
  Effects,
  entry_default as default
};
